title: Amongst Us
summary: A woman is found suffocated with coins put in her mouth. Dwayne is initially viewed as a suspect because he was last seen with the woman.
method: The killer broke into the victim's house after Dwayne left. Her dog didn't bark because it knew the killer.
motive: The victim was hiding under an assumed name on the island to escape her ex. She had evidence that would implicate him in a money laundering operation.
killer: Aidan Miles, which is Nadia Selim backwards, also, Catherine's love interest
notes: DI Chris Ricketts is on the island to investigate the case as well. Him breaking into the house earlier in the episode doesn't make sense because he looked suspicious and didn't tell the team. It's also weird how only in this episode they established Catherine has been seeing someone. Maybe it would've made more sense had he been in more episodes but he's very suspicious as he's an unaccounted for character in the episode.
